description:
OCEAN ONE is a 35.29-metre Azimut Grande 36M delivered in 2023, extended with an opening beach club. Her exterior is designed by Alberto Mancini and her interior styled by Salvagni Architetti, with a GRP hull, carbon fibre superstructure and teak decks.

She sleeps 10 guests (plus 2) in 5 cabins: a master, two doubles and two convertible twins with Pullman beds, with a captain and 6 crew. Three decks of outdoor living include an infinity pool on the bow, a sky deck and the beach club.

Twin MTU engines of 2,186 hp give a cruising speed of 18 knots and a top speed of 24 knots, with Humphree fin stabilisers. Her toys are exceptional: a BRABUS Shadow 900 chase boat, 2 Seabobs, an e-foil, an electric jetsurf, 2 Seadoo Spark jet skis, a SeaRaft platform and a 50 m² floating platform with swimming pool.

Available for charter in the Mediterranean. Contact Yacht Research for availability.
